description: This file defines the PdfNumberTreeNode class, which represents a node in a PDF number tree structure. It includes methods for managing child nodes, adding key-value pairs, and updating limits, with many properties and methods related to managing the hierarchical structure of number trees within PDF documents.

classes.name: PdfNumberTreeNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a PDF number tree structure, handling child nodes and key-value pairs with properties for node limits and methods for modifications.

methods.name: PdfNumberTreeNode
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new node, indicating if it is a root node.

methods.name: AddKid
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: AddNumber
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the Number array of the node.

methods.name: UpdateLimits
methods.description: Updates the node's limits based on its children and entries (not yet implemented).

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the node for saving by updating limits.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Overrides the write operation, currently calls the base implementation.
